explanation: Correct the diagnosed sample-selection failure without changing its threshold. The original top spread, 0.00508093 m, is below 3 times the preserved 0.00174137 m guard, although residual and normal checks pass. At the actual unchanged frame 216, retain the fresh original landmarks, counter and wall measurements and request at most two genuinely different sets of top-face interior samples distributed across both dimensions. Accept each sample only after membership, measurement-error, frame and individual surface-identity checks; augment the plane support and recompute the same screen. Do not replay any acknowledged motion. The guard never decreases during refinement, and passing this measurement gate still grants no physical-action permission. Preserve all existing separate orientation, clearance, overlap, closure and retained-lift gates.
interface: Apply these three exact replacements to the existing main(api), implementing alternate_pickup only. Return fields remain stage_status, reason, evidence, handoff and completion_proposed=false. No new checkpoint keys. alt.model stores the original compact observation, accepted supplemental top-plane point receipts with review frames and surface identity, and numerical quality diagnostics; a partial refinement also retains its latest compact review and measurement errors. The final model keeps supplemental_top_plane_support alongside its original top_landmarks, plane and orientation screens. Supplemental samples are fit support, not renamed persistent landmarks. Original t0..t3 IDs and subsequent stationarity checks are unchanged. alt.failure records the failed gate, prevented action, measured spread, preserved guard, threshold, residual margins and observation frame. alt.progress and alt.effect retain their existing acknowledged-motion and differential-lift provenance. All coordinates remain world meters, tool quaternions xyzw, and image pixels top-left. Existing handoff and its limitations remain unchanged.
jev_protocol:
The seven existing real-Jev questions are preserved. Each x/y/z/rx/ry/rz question reads its explicit state.processed_features.axes.<axis>.goal_relation: decrease selects negative, within_tolerance selects hold, and increase selects positive. Translation signs refer to world coordinates; rotation signs refer to world rotation-vector components. The gripper question reads state.processed_features.objective.gripper and delivers open, close or keep unchanged; this stage never requests reopening. Numerical geometry, uncertainty, frame provenance and action-specific permissions are computed or observed by the program and supplied as features. Jev is neither an image observer nor a metric calculator.

The new measurement-only loop performs zero physical commands and at most two fresh reviews with different top-face sampling. All physical actions still use api.drive or api.control. Existing drive leases remain bounded to at most 16 calls and three leases, with phase-specific reserves, three native steps per update, 0.008 m translation and 0.08 rad rotation limits. Continuation after lease_exhausted requires whole-lease measured progress above 0.0003 m or 0.003 rad; stalls and ineffective corrections stop. Alignment and lift retain 0.002 m position tolerance; contact descent retains 0.0005 m and 0.01 rad tolerances incorporated in geometric allowances. Separate reviews authorize high alignment, descent, closure and test lift. Closure remains a single fixed-pose episode of at most four updates with actual counter-clearance checks.

Neither the improved plane fit nor pose attainment establishes pickup. Stage completion still requires fresh same-package identity, visible counter separation and retained opposed contact, plus object motion compared with actual hand motion using geo.attachment_error. Required hand rise remains max(0.020 m,6u), object rise max(0.015 m,4u), attachment error at most 2u+0.002 m and rotation change at most 0.04 rad. Independently identified landmarks can replace optional quality-checked tracking; unknown tracking supplies no pose. No clearance, overlap, noise, stopping or retained-effect threshold is relaxed.
